goal: The barkdown command reaches what a person can still only do by hand: edit, undo, recover and delete notes; export and import profiles; the Paper switch; provider sign-in; goals; images on a message. Same gate, same tiers, same never-list.
scope: A. Notes: note edit (append or replace, revision-checked, with the Undo receipt), note undo, note deleted, note recover, note delete
B. Profiles: profile export to a folder, profile import from one, the portable outcome, discarding an unfinished import
C. The Paper switch: status, compare, switch, rollback, reconcile one changed note
D. Provider sign-in: check, sign in (finished by a person in the browser), its state, cancel
E. Goals: list, new, start, pause, cancel, open; review and termination stay a person's
F. Images on chat send and agent add
G. Unit and live proof, pictures, records
acceptance: Every new command is in the catalogue with a handler; unit tests prove the tiers, the never-list additions and the argument rules
A live tour in real Electron drives the new commands through the launcher the app writes
Pictures reviewed, verify green, handoff, README and roadmap current
nextAction: Build slices A–F in app/shared/control-commands.js, app/main/main.js and app/renderer/src/control.js; extend control.test.mjs and control.live.mjs.
